forbidden.name: tenant-tables-only-repositories
forbidden.comment: I1: tenant tables live in packages/db (ADR-0055) and are reached only through its repositories; identity tables and tests are explicit exceptions.

forbidden.name: modules-only-core
forbidden.comment: I13: a module imports only @backbricks/core and its own files; collaboration goes through capabilities.

forbidden.name: modules-no-database
forbidden.comment: ADR-0055: modules declare repository interfaces; tables, migrations and queries live in packages/db.

forbidden.name: core-no-internal-deps
forbidden.comment: core defines contracts and pure logic and depends on nothing internal (AGENTS.md §2.1).

forbidden.name: leaf-packages-no-internal-deps
forbidden.comment: ui and api-contract are leaves: shared by apps and clients, so they import nothing internal.

forbidden.name: clients-only-contract
forbidden.comment: I18: the MIT packages sdk and cli never import AGPL code, only api-contract types (cli may use the sdk).

forbidden.name: examples-only-mit
forbidden.comment: I18: the MIT examples use the SDK (and its contract types), never AGPL code.

forbidden.name: www-only-ui
forbidden.comment: ADR-0001: the website imports only packages/ui, never server code.

forbidden.name: web-only-ui-and-contract
forbidden.comment: The dashboard uses packages/ui and the API contract (later the generated admin client from the sdk), never server code.

forbidden.name: no-app-imports
forbidden.comment: Apps are composition roots; nothing imports from another app.

forbidden.name: no-relative-imports-across-packages
forbidden.comment: Other packages are imported by name through their exports, never via relative paths (AGENTS.md §2.4).

forbidden.name: no-deep-imports
forbidden.comment: Public functions of a package are exported through its index.ts; deep imports are not allowed (AGENTS.md §2.4).

forbidden.name: not-to-undeclared-deps
forbidden.comment: Every imported npm package must be declared in the importing package's package.json.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-deps
forbidden.comment: Production code must not import devDependencies (the image installs production dependencies only).
